The first release of Henkan: convert files from the Explorer right-click menu.

## Install

Download **Henkan-0.0.1-Setup.exe** below and run it. Afterwards, right-click any file
and choose **Henkan**.

Windows may show "Windows protected your PC" first, because the installer is not signed
by a commercial certificate authority. Choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**. The
setup then asks once for administrator rights, to trust the certificate Henkan's package
is signed with, and installs Henkan for your account. It appears under
**Settings > Apps** and is removed from there like any other app.

**Henkan-0.0.1-x64.msix** is the package on its own, for Intune, Configuration Manager
and other deployment tools. Its signing certificate has to be trusted on the target
machines first (it is embedded in the package's digital signature). The setup can also
be run unattended with `/VERYSILENT`.

## What is in it

- Over 180 conversions: Word, Excel and PowerPoint in every format they save,
  templates and macro files included; PDF to images, text or PDF/A, and PDFs merged
  into one; images to every common format; slides to video; H.264, H.265 and AV1
  video; lossless and lossy audio; ZIP, 7z and TAR.GZ, and extracting archives.
- One page, **Conversions**, to choose what the Explorer menu offers and with which
  settings, and to add variants such as MP3 at 320 kbit/s next to the usual MP3.
- Progress as a small card in a screen corner, a window, a Windows notification or
  nothing, as you prefer.
- `henkanc`, the same engine on the command line.

FFmpeg, Ghostscript, 7-Zip and ImageMagick come with Henkan. Document conversions use
Microsoft Office when it is installed and LibreOffice when it is not.

## Requirements

Windows 11, 64-bit. This release has not been tested on Windows 10.
